title: EvidenceAgentOutput
description: Structured scholarly evidence output produced by the Evidence Agent

query_summary.description: Normalized description of the literature search query executed

not_found.description: True if no verified scholarly literature meeting inclusion criteria was identified

not_found_reason.description: Detailed justification when reliable evidence was not found

overall_evidence_quality.description: Aggregate GRADE-style quality assessment of identified studies

studies.description: List of verified scientific publications matching the research question

study_title.description: Exact title of the published article

authors_or_organization.description: Primary author (e.g. Smith et al.) or collaborative research group

sample_size.description: Number of participants or included trials (e.g., 'n=450' or '18 RCTs, 2,140 patients')

url.description: Direct, verified URL to PubMed, DOI, or official journal page

primary_endpoints.description: Endpoints evaluated (e.g. 30-day morbidity, length of stay, complications)

key_findings.description: Objective summary of supported clinical and surgical findings

effect_estimates.description: Summary metrics if reported (e.g. RR 0.72 [95% CI 0.55-0.94], p=0.02)

limitations.description: Key methodological or generalizability limitations identified in the study

conflicting_notes.description: Specific conflicts or discrepancies compared to other literature

evidence_synthesis.description: Cohesive summary synthesizing all identified literature
